name: qr
title: QR code
description: A QR code as a picture with its words beside it: a UPI link, a ticket number, a Wi-Fi password. The encoder is in the component (numeric, alphanumeric and UTF-8 byte modes, versions 1 to 40, levels L to H, all eight masks) with no dependency, tested against the standard's example, a reference encoder and a decoder. The words are the builder's own text, selectable and wrapping; the code is one SVG path on a plate that stays light in dark mode and in forced colours. Quiet is a white plate; warm a paper plate with a hand-ruled frame; playful adds block-print studs and draws the frame on once. The modules never change.

budget.reason: Parts per decision 0010: element qr.js 4,740 bytes; pure encoder qr.core.js 13,656 bytes (over 0010's 12 KB, within the 14 KB that decision 0026 gives it: the capacity tables, Reed-Solomon, interleaving, the eight masks and four penalty rules); pure helpers qr.helpers.js 5,222 bytes (the checked UPI and Wi-Fi payloads, the seeded frame, the size floor); skins quiet 142, warm 2,642 (also the frame builder playful uses) and playful 387 bytes. Today 26,789 bytes in all. No frame loop: the frame draws on with two Web Animations, once, in playful only.

motif.gloss: The diamond cuts of Indian block printing, as on the stamp's frame, set as studs on a plate.
